tytul: Metka: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for metka, a raw smoked spreadable sausage made from minced meat, with onion or in the salmon style, and eaten without cooking (Polish metka cebulowa and metka łososiowa). [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to UGA, uncooked smoked sausages are smoked for flavor development and must be fully cooked before eating. [T:MIE-022]
Cold-smoke temperatures are not hot enough to kill bacteria and may even help them grow. [T:MIE-076]
Too much nitrate or nitrite can be toxic to people. [T:MIE-011]

akapity: Metka is eaten without cooking, so it does not meet this UGA rule. [T:MIE-022]
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for metka from a checked source. [T:-]
